mapper.select: SELECT COL_ID AS "colId" , COL_NM AS "colNm" , COL_WIDTH AS "width" , ALIGN AS "align" , DISP_TYPE AS "dispType" , EDIT_TYPE AS "editType" , DATA_TYPE AS "dataType" FROM GRID_COL_DEF WHERE GRID_ID = #{gridId} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORD

SELECT '0' AS "chk" , EMP_ID AS "empId" , EMP_NM AS "empNm" , DEPT_NM AS "deptNm" , HIRE_DT AS "hireDt" , SALARY AS "salary" FROM DYN_EMP WHERE 1 = 1
AND (EMP_NM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR DEPT_NM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY EMP_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DYN_EMP (EMP_ID, EMP_NM, DEPT_NM, HIRE_DT, SALARY) VALUES (#{empId}, #{empNm}, #{deptNm}, #{hireDt}, #{salary})

SELECT DEPT_CD AS "deptCd" , DEPT_NM AS "deptNm" , MGR_NM AS "mgrNm" , EMP_CNT AS "empCnt" FROM DYN_DEPT WHERE 1 = 1
AND DEPT_NM LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY DEPT_CD
